title: Shopkeeper's throw
description: The shopkeeper follows the player while he holds an unpaid pistol, and stands still once he pays. Shot with it, the shopkeeper falls stunned and drops his shotgun; he gets up angry, grabs the player and throws him against the floor, which costs a heart.
